stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy has signed a lease on premises two doors along and plans to move in five weeks. Its manager will write to the Board a week beforehand describing the new layout. What does the regulation require?

choices.text: Written notice a week ahead is sufficient for a move within the same block.
Board approval before relocating, on an application filed at least 90 days ahead.
Board approval before relocating, on an application filed at least 14 days ahead.
Nothing before the move, provided the new address is reported within 14 days.
A fresh licence application, the existing licence lapsing on the day of the move.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 6.16 requires a pharmacy to APPLY TO THE BOARD FOR APPROVAL to relocate PRIOR TO RELOCATING and provides it MAY NOT RELOCATE UNTIL IT RECEIVES APPROVAL. The application is submitted AT LEAST 90 DAYS before the desired relocation date unless the Board approves otherwise, with the fee and blueprints or equivalent architectural drawings.

choice_analysis.A: Distance does not alter the requirement, and notice is not approval.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: prior approval on a 90-day application.
choice_analysis.C: Fourteen days is the closure notice period, not the relocation lead time.
choice_analysis.D: The move may not happen before approval.
choice_analysis.E: The regulation contemplates approval to relocate, not a lapse and reapplication.

related_facts: The application carries the fee and drawings depicting the pharmacy layout
explanation.mpje_trap: Candidates borrow the familiar 14-day closure period and treat the move as a notification.

reasoning_steps: Note that the regulation requires approval rather than notice
Note the prohibition on relocating before approval
